intro f g k W M hf hg hM hW
have hs := (yui_aux_0029 T gamma R h_T016 h_T013 f g k hf hg).mul_left M
have hb : ∀ (n : ℕ) (j : ℤ), ‖W j * KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) f j * KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) g (k-j)‖ ≤ M*(‖f j‖*‖g (k-j)‖) := by
  intro n j
  simp only [norm_mul]
  calc
    _ ≤ M*‖f j‖*‖g (k-j)‖ := mul_le_mul
      (mul_le_mul (hW j) ((yui_aux_0032 T gamma R h_T016 h_T013 f).1 _ j) (norm_nonneg _) hM)
      ((yui_aux_0032 T gamma R h_T016 h_T013 g).1 _ (k-j)) (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by ring
constructor
· intro n
  have hnorm : Summable (fun j : ℤ => ‖W j * KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) f j * KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) g (k-j)‖) := hs.of_nonneg_of_le (fun j => norm_nonneg _) (hb n)
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑' j : ℤ, ‖W j * KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) f j * KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) g (k-j)‖ := norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm hnorm
    _ ≤ ∑' j : ℤ, M*(‖f j‖*‖g (k-j)‖) := hnorm.tsum_le_tsum (hb n) hs
    _ = _ := tsum_mul_left
· apply tendsto_tsum_of_dominated_convergence hs
  · intro j
    apply tendsto_const_nhds.congr'
    filter_upwards [(yui_aux_0032 T gamma R h_T016 h_T013 f).2.1 j, (yui_aux_0032 T gamma R h_T016 h_T013 g).2.1 (k-j)] with n hfn hgn
    rw [hfn, hgn]
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall hb
